mainEntity.name: Are structured group workouts suitable for beginners?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, structured group workouts at Cave Training are suitable for beginners. Coaches provide modifications for exercises, ensuring participants of all fitness levels can safely and effectively complete the workout. It's crucial to communicate your experience level and any physical limitations to your coach beforehand. This allows them to suggest appropriate scaling options, helping you build foundational strength and technique gradually.
